description: This Rust source file implements a module bundler that processes JavaScript/TypeScript files, resolving dependencies, transforming modules from ESM to CommonJS, and bundling them into a single executable bundle. It handles different import types (JSON, Text, Binary), manages import conflicts, and generates a self-invoking bundle function with module definitions.

classes.name: Module
classes.description: Represents a module with a unique key and its contents, which can be code as a string or raw binary data.

classes.name: Rewriter
classes.description: Handles the transformation of modules from ESM to CommonJS, tracking imports and exports.

classes.name: RewriterState
classes.description: Maintains state during module rewriting, including import sets, import types, export statements, and error collection.

methods.name: bundle
methods.description: Main function that takes a path and a module specifier, resolves dependencies, transforms modules, and produces a bundled JavaScript string.

methods.name: module_key_to_relative_path
methods.description: Converts a ModuleKey to a relative path string based on a base directory.

methods.name: build_require_call
methods.description: Constructs a require() call expression for a given module key.

methods.name: build_module_exports
methods.description: Creates a member expression referencing module.exports.

methods.name: build_module_exports_assignment
methods.description: Creates an assignment statement to export a value under a specific name.

methods.name: extract_import_type
methods.description: Extracts import type (json, text, binary) from a module's with clause attributes.

methods.name: resolve_import
methods.description: Resolves a source specifier to a ModuleKey, handling errors.

methods.name: build_const_declaration
methods.description: Creates a const variable declaration with a given binding pattern and initializer.

methods.name: commonjs_export_name
methods.description: Creates an export assignment for a given identifier name.
